g.text: LLD 1 · A full run: Run.full, then Run.report (scripts/resolve.py --input … --output …)
every step after load reads records
: count every key's pairs before any join; flag blocks too big to join blind
: learn the model from the file itself, without labels; measure u on this file
: join the certain cases, the first rule wins; cluster them
: list the pairs worth scoring; check big blocks on a sample
: give every candidate pair its evidence in bits
: accept pairs at the threshold with a name compared; join pairs into entities
: save the answer and the state for increments; the old run goes only once all is written
: write the checks and the sheets for people
